# Welcome to WildBlock SMP – Season 2 _modpack_

## A Fresh Start

Welcome to **WildBlock SMP Season 2**, a modded Minecraft survival experience focused on exploration, creativity, automation, and community gameplay.

Season 2 brings a completely fresh world with new opportunities, bigger projects, and an improved modded survival experience for both new and returning players.

This modpack is created and maintaind by **jjjoepie**
the server are created and maintained by **Meesiemees**.

---

## Main Mods

### Create

The **Create Mod** completely changes the way automation works in Minecraft.

Instead of simple machines, Create allows players to build fully mechanical systems using:
- Gears
- Conveyor belts
- Windmills
- Water wheels
- Trains
- Factories
- Automatic farms
- Storage systems

The mod focuses heavily on creativity and engineering, allowing players to design their own unique machines and production systems.

Whether you want a small workshop or a massive industrial factory, Create gives you the tools to build almost anything you can imagine.

---

### Biomes O’ Plenty

With **Biomes O’ Plenty**, the world generation is expanded with dozens of new biomes, trees, plants, and environments.

You will discover:
- Huge forests
- Mountain ranges
- Fantasy landscapes
- Colorful valleys
- Swamps
- Snowy regions
- Unique building locations

Exploration becomes much more important and every journey across the world feels different.

---

## Multiplayer Survival

WildBlock SMP is designed around long-term multiplayer survival.

Players can:
- Build towns together
- Trade resources
- Create large community projects
- Explore the world
- Build giant bases
- Start rail networks
- Work on factories and farms
- Play together with friends

The server is focused on creating a relaxed and enjoyable community where players can progress at their own pace.

---

## Season 2

Season 2 is all about:
- Bigger builds
- Better automation
- More exploration
- Community projects
- Long-term survival
- Creative freedom

The combination of Create and Biomes O’ Plenty creates a world full of possibilities for both technical players and builders.

---

# Start Your Adventure

Join WildBlock SMP Season 2 and create your own story in a world built for creativity, exploration, and multiplayer survival.
